_readme: Trips Aastha took but never named in a caption, so the caption scan cannot find them.
Vietnam is the proof: zero posts out of 2,089 mention it, yet she was there.
One entry per journey. 'countries' can list several for a multi-country trip.
'start' and 'end' are YYYY-MM-DD. If only the month is known, put the same date in
both and the card will show just the month, which claims nothing it cannot back up.
Entries with an empty start date are skipped, so half-finished rows do no harm.
'postLinks' are Instagram links to posts made on that trip, even when the caption
never says where it was. Their photos and view counts get pulled in automatically.
Known countries and where their dot sits: scripts/scan-travel.mjs and the EXTRA_POS
After editing, run:  node scripts/fetch-manual-posts.mjs && node scripts/build-travel-map.mjs

trips.note: Amit gave the exact dates on 31 Aug 2026: 18 to 21 December 2025. The reel below went up on 30 Dec, after she was home, which is why the date on the post does not match the trip.
